Draft a quote header only (attach items later)
Malaysian SST quote with prices that already include the tax: one 8% service line and one 10% goods line

failure_modes.recovery: Resend with the value the error names: it lists the codes that apply on the issue date and the rate with its source. Under a scheme, leave tax_rate_bps out.
failure_modes.when: tax_scheme is not sg_gst, my_sst or none; a tax_code is not a code of the scheme or does not apply on the issue date; a my_sst line has no tax_code; tax_rate_bps differs from the scheme's rate on the issue date; tax_code, an fx rate or (except on a cash sale invoice) prices_include_tax came without a tax_scheme; or the fx rate is not a positive decimal of up to 6 decimals, comes without fx_rate_date, or is on an SGD or my_sst document

failure_modes.recovery: Send the call without tax_scheme, prices_include_tax, tax_code and the fx fields for now (a cash sale that holds its tax waits: without the flag the rate is added on top); the owner runs `pnpm db:seed` to enable them.
failure_modes.when: a tax scheme field was sent and the platform catalog does not list the tax scheme fields yet (SIMPLER_SALES_TAX_MODEL_UNSEEDED)

preconditions: quote_number is server-claimed (atomic per-tenant sequence) — any value you send is ignored.

ONE CALL does the whole quote: pass `items` [{description, quantity, unit_price_cents}] (integer CENTS: $15.00 → 1500) and the door creates the quote + all line rows; quote_item_create remains for adding lines later.

valid_until is epoch millis, and the quote prints the calendar day that instant falls on in the business time zone (sales_settings.timezone, unset = Asia/Singapore). For a valid-until date, send 12:00 UTC of that date (30 Sep 2026 = 1790769600000): it falls on that date in every listed zone, while 00:00 UTC falls on the day before west of UTC.

tax_scheme sg_gst (Singapore GST) or my_sst (Malaysia SST) prices each line by its tax_code from Simpler's dated rulebook: sg_gst codes standard (the GST rate on the issue date, 9% since 1 Jan 2024), zero_rated, exempt, out_of_scope; my_sst codes sales_10, sales_5, service_8, service_6, exempt (every my_sst line needs one). Left out, tax_scheme is your sales settings' tax_scheme; "none" (or null) prices by tax_rate_bps as before. Under a scheme, tax_rate_bps is resolved for you: a different value is refused naming the rate and its source. prices_include_tax true means unit prices already include the tax. tax_scheme and prices_include_tax cannot change after creation: create a new document with the ones you want (Duplicate on the web page).

With items, the answer echoes items_total_cents (the lines as sent, added up: check it against your items), subtotal_cents (before tax; under prices that include tax, the net inside them), tax_cents and total_cents (what the document charges; a cash sale's is the amount taken).

description: ONE call creates the whole document: claims the next atomic quote number, then writes the header plus every line in `items` ([{description, quantity, unit_price_cents}], integer CENTS) together. client_name resolves an existing client by name or creates one. tax_scheme sg_gst or my_sst taxes each line by its tax_code (refusals: see tax_scheme). When present, the second content block is the quote as copy-ready text, shown with a Copy button where the host draws MCP Apps; if the user says they cannot see the quote, give them that block word for word; make a client link with quote_share only when the user asks for one. NEXT: quote_convert to turn the quote into its invoice.

client_name.description: Client by NAME — resolves to an existing client or creates one (no client_id lookup needed).

force.description: Confirms a create whose notes or single line item read like a payment RECEIVED or a write-off rather than a new bill — resend the SAME call with force:true to create it anyway. No effect on quote_create (the intent trap is invoice-only).

items.description: ONE call creates the whole document — line items in integer CENTS ($15.00 → 1500), or unit_price as a decimal string. quantity takes up to 3 decimals (1.5 hours → 1.5); unit is an optional label (hr, kg); discount_bps is an optional line discount (10% → 1000). tax_code is the line's tax under the document's tax_scheme (sg_gst: standard, zero_rated, exempt, out_of_scope, default standard; my_sst: sales_10, sales_5, service_8, service_6, exempt, required); refused without a tax_scheme.

prices_include_tax.description: true = unit prices already include the tax (the tax is worked back out of each line). Default false. Needs a tax_scheme.

tax_scheme.description: sg_gst (Singapore GST) or my_sst (Malaysia SST): each line is taxed by its tax_code at the rate in force on the issue date. Under a scheme, a tax_rate_bps other than that rate, an unknown tax_code and a my_sst line without one are refused, naming the valid codes and the rate's source. "none" = no scheme, priced by tax_rate_bps. Left out = your sales settings' tax_scheme.
